ars_conflux.validation.one_payload: Only one replacement projectile glyph is allowed per phrase.
ars_conflux.glyph_desc.glyph_nearby_alli: Resolve subsequent effects on nearby allies, excluding yourself. AOE increases the radius. Selected allies do not become the caster or payer.
ars_conflux.cast.denied: This spell cannot be cast right now.
ars_conflux.glyph_desc.glyph_propagate_n: Converts the rest of the spell to Nearby Allies, centered on the original caster. Area of Effect extends the search radius. Ownership and payment stay with the original caster.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_propagate: Increases the original form's search radius.
ars_conflux.glyph_desc.glyph_propagate_c: Converts the rest of the spell to Ars Elemental's Carian Phalanx around the original caster. Uses the original formation, targeting and five-projectile limit. Split adds projectiles.
